component.name: COMPAS recidivism risk scores (Broward County, Florida)
component.description: Commercial risk assessment that gives each defendant a decile score from 1 (lowest risk) to 10. ProPublica obtained the scores given in Broward County in 2013 and 2014 and matched them with criminal records over the next two years. This audit treats a decile of 1 to 4 as a low-risk (favourable) decision, as ProPublica did.

useCases: Assess the risk that a defendant will reoffend, to inform pre-trial decisions.

ethicalConsiderations.name: R-01: Group fairness
ethicalConsiderations.mitigationStrategy: Investigate the drivers of the gap (see proxy-feature results), consider reweighing or threshold adjustment, and document a fairness rationale approved by the risk owner. Attributes needing action: race, age_cat.

ethicalConsiderations.name: R-02: Intersectional fairness
ethicalConsiderations.mitigationStrategy: Report subgroup metrics alongside single-attribute metrics and set an explicit subgroup tolerance. Collect more data for subgroups below the minimum sample size.

ethicalConsiderations.name: R-03: Proxy-feature screening
ethicalConsiderations.mitigationStrategy: For each flagged feature, document a business justification, test model variants without it, and compare fairness and performance. Remove protected attributes from inputs unless a documented legal basis allows them.

ethicalConsiderations.name: R-04: Calibration
ethicalConsiderations.mitigationStrategy: Apply isotonic or Platt calibration on a held-out set and re-check per group.

ethicalConsiderations.name: R-05: Predictive performance
ethicalConsiderations.mitigationStrategy: Track AUC in production monitoring with an alert at the declared minimum.

ethicalConsiderations.name: R-06: Risk classification
ethicalConsiderations.mitigationStrategy: Record the classification and its basis in the AI inventory, have the accountable executive sign it off, and plan for each upcoming obligation.
